messages.content:
Risk: Non-disclosure
Description: Content might not be clearly disclosed as AI generated.
Concern: Users must be notified when they are interacting with an AI system. Not disclosing the AI-authored content can result in a lack of transparency.
Policy: Patient Consent

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0004804: high risk sexual behaviour AE — This is an AE which is the description of the activity that will increase the probability that a person engaging in sexual activity with another person infected with a sexually transmitted infection will be infected or become pregnant, or make a partner pregnant. [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: somnambulism AE, attention-seeking behaviour AE, somatoform disorder AE
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 6/7 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 5/7 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SocialEngineeringFraud: Social Engineering Fraud — Manipulation of individuals through psychological tactics to gain trust, extract confidential information, or persuade victims to take actions against their interests. [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty

axes.rationale: The risk of non-disclosure is directly related to the actions of the AI system, which is the agent in this context.
The risk of non-disclosure involves the autonomous actions of the AI, making the concept of an agent highly relevant.
